title: Resident Evil 2 Fixed-Camera Rendering with WebGPU and Rust
description: Build a Resident Evil-style WebGPU scene in Rust with fixed camera cuts, glTF skinning, tank controls, pre-rendered backgrounds, and debug overlays.
imageAlt: Claire Redfield standing before the rainy R.P.D. front gate in a WebGPU fixed-camera scene with a small status and model-credit overlay.
